text:
Zoe: follow-up from all-hands Q on international travel + visas — putting the FAQ items here so managers can share.

Ahmed: thanks Zoe. what are the main questions?

Zoe: 1) visa letters and invitation support — who issues them? 2) upfront booking rules for international hotels/flights 3) per-diem vs actuals for meals 4) corporate card vs personal pay + reimburse timeline

Priya: short answers: visa letters — People Ops issues invitation letters for business travel if request submitted 4 weeks before travel. travel admin (travel-bot) will draft the standard template; manager must confirm attendees.

travel-bot: Visa letter template created: https://intranet.redwood/ops/visa-letter-template (auto). Submit via People Ops form -> attach passport name + nationality.

Ahmed: booking rules: international flights should be booked at least 21 days in advance when possible. refundable vs non-refundable: refundable allowed up to $800/night for hotels without extra sign-off; non-refundable or anything >$800 requires People Ops review. For >8 hour time-zone shifts, prefer premium economy or business for flights >8h with Director approval for upgrades.

Zoe: per-diem? managers asked if per-diem differs by country.

Priya: yes, per-diem scales by region. baseline: domestic $75/day; OECD standard countries $100/day; high-cost regions $150/day. Alternatively submit actuals with receipts for reimbursement. We'll add a country list to the FAQ.

Ahmed: corporate card guidance: use corporate card for flights/hotels when possible. If not available, personal card + expense submission. reimbursement timeline: People Ops commits 7 business days on approved expenses; expedited reimbursements possible with manager note.

Zoe: question on training vs client travel for visas: if someone is attending client on-site and training in same trip, is visa support the same?

Priya: yes, business visa support covers both if trip is business-approved. include itinerary and client PO if applicable.

travel-bot: Note: COVID or public health restrictions — check country guidance link: https://intranet.redwood/ops/travel-health (auto). If destination requires quarantine, travel requires Director pre-approval and a mitigation plan.

Zoe: can we get a 1-pager for managers summarizing timelines (visa letter 4w, flight booking 21d, per-diem tiers, corp card rules)?

peopleops-bot: Draft manager 1-pager uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/ops/manager-international-travel-onepager (auto). ETA final: Wed EOD.

Ahmed: thanks all. I'll drop this summary in the eng-managers channel and flag any folks traveling next month. DM me for urgent approvals. :white_check_mark:
